name: blockchainanalysis
description: On-chain compliance checks for crypto wallets and tokens: stablecoin issuer freezes and their history, token honeypot checks, token approvals, and a clear / flagged / unknown wallet verdict.

interface.longDescription:
Check crypto wallets and tokens against on-chain facts before you transact or write a compliance note.

What it does:
- Stablecoin freezes: whether Tether, Circle, Paxos, First Digital or another issuer has blacklisted an address right now, read directly from the issuer's contract on 15 chains.
- Freeze history: every freeze, unfreeze and destroy event an issuer recorded on-chain for an address, with block, date and transaction.
- Token security: a simulated buy and sell of an ERC-20 token to surface honeypots, extreme transfer taxes, impersonation and active mint authority, on Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Optimism, Polygon and Arbitrum.
- Token approvals: which addresses can move a wallet's ERC-20 tokens on Ethereum, with risky or unlimited allowances flagged.
- Wallet verdict: clear, flagged or unknown, with the top risk category, screened against BlockchainAnalysis entity labels and live freeze state.

Who it is for: compliance and AML teams, accountants and lawyers handling crypto, and anyone checking a counterparty or a token.

Limits: results report observed on-chain facts and labels at check time, never the cause or intent behind them. A result with no signals is not a guarantee that an address or token is safe. The plugin only reads public blockchain data: it never sends transactions, moves funds or revokes approvals.
defaultPrompt: Is 0x12d66f87a04a9e220743712ce6d9bb1b5616b8fc frozen by any stablecoin issuer on Ethereum?
Is this token safe to buy? 0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7 on Ethereum
Which token approvals are open on this Ethereum wallet?

positive.description: Current stablecoin freeze on an address
positive.prompt: Is 0x12d66f87a04a9e220743712ce6d9bb1b5616b8fc frozen by any stablecoin issuer on Ethereum?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that the address is frozen on Ethereum at check time, with Paxos (USDP) as the issuer that blacklists it. Does not state a cause for the freeze.

positive.description: Freeze and unfreeze history of an address
positive.prompt: Show the stablecoin freeze and unfreeze history of 0x12d66f87a04a9e220743712ce6d9bb1b5616b8fc.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the on-chain freeze and unfreeze events for the address, newest first, each with issuer, token, chain, date and transaction hash. Includes Tether (USDT) unfreezing it on Ethereum on 2025-03-24.

positive.description: Token security check on a well-known token
positive.prompt: Is this token safe to buy? 0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7 on Ethereum
positive.expected_behavior: Reports no security signals for the token at scan time and states that the absence of signals is not a guarantee of safety. No transaction is sent.

positive.description: Open token approvals of a wallet
positive.prompt: Which token approvals are open on Ethereum wallet 0x28c6c06298d514db089934071355e5743bf21d60?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the wallet's active ERC-20 approvals on Ethereum with the spender of each and an overall wallet risk tier. Does not revoke anything.

positive.prompt: Give me a compliance verdict on wallet 0x12d66f87a04a9e220743712ce6d9bb1b5616b8fc on Ethereum.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the verdict 'flagged' with top category FROZEN and notes the address is currently frozen.

negative.description: Moving funds is out of scope
negative.prompt: Send 100 USDC from my wallet to 0x28c6c06298d514db089934071355e5743bf21d60.

negative.description: Changing an issuer's freeze is out of scope
negative.prompt: Unfreeze 0x12d66f87a04a9e220743712ce6d9bb1b5616b8fc so I can use my USDP again.

negative.description: Identifying the private person behind a wallet is out of scope
negative.prompt: Tell me the full name and home address of the person who owns 0x12d66f87a04a9e220743712ce6d9bb1b5616b8fc.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or services and does not process payments. It only reads public blockchain data.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: stablecoin freeze status and history, token security, token approvals and wallet verdict.
